SELECT
  n.n_name AS n_name,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS late_pct
FROM
  region r
  JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE
  r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
  AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY
  n.n_name
ORDER BY
  late_pct DESC

            c.c_name,

    WITH customer_totals AS (
        SELECT
            c.c_mktsegment,
            c.c_name,
            SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent
        FROM customer c
        JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
        WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01'
        GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment, c.c_name
    )
    SELECT
        c_mktsegment,
        c_name,
        total_spent,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment) AS rnk
    FROM customer_totals
    ORDER BY c_mktsegment, rnk;
    ```

WITH nation_customer_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    r.r_name,
    n.n_name,
    COUNT(c.c_custkey) AS customer_count
  FROM region r
  JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
  GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name
)
SELECT 
  r_name,
  n_name,
  customer_count
FROM nation_customer_counts
WHERE customer_count = (
  SELECT MAX(customer_count)
  FROM nation_customer_counts
)
ORDER BY r_name, n_name

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM
        supplier s
        JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE
        l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01'
        AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        s.s_suppkey, s.s_name
)
SELECT
    s_name,
    revenue
FROM
    supplier_revenue
WHERE
    revenue > 1.2 * (
        SELECT AVG(revenue)
        FROM supplier_revenue
    )
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC

  SELECT 
    r.r_name,
    n.n_name,
    COUNT(c.c_custkey) AS customer_count
  FROM region r
  JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
  GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name
)
SELECT 
  r_name,
  n_name,
  customer_count
FROM regional_customer_counts

    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,

    (SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) - SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity)) / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS margin

SELECT 
  n1.n_name AS cust_region,
  n2.n_name AS supp_region,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey

            SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
        FROM
            supplier s
            JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
        WHERE

        GROUP BY

    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
    customer c
JOIN
    orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
WHERE
    o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'

        WHERE o2.o_custkey = c.c_custkey AND o2.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o2.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
    )
GROUP BY
    c.c_mktsegment
ORDER BY
    c.c_mktsegment

SELECT
    n.n_name,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS late_pct
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN
    nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN
    region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    late_pct DESC

SELECT 
  n1.n_regionkey AS cust_region,
  n2.n_regionkey AS supp_region,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n2 ON s.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey

        COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_count

SELECT c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customer c
JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1993-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-12-31'
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment, c.c_custkey
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1

SELECT 
  r.r_name,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_price
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n2 ON s.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE n2.n_name = n.n_name
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY r.r_name
